1917233888524489199 [2025-04-29] @alexeheath 💜 89 🔁 22 [(SEED) type=semantic_search]
Meta is releasing a standalone mobile app for its ChatGPT competitor, Meta AI. 

There's a Discover feed that shows interactions that others (including your IG/FB friends) are having with the assistant. Meta tells me the idea is to demystify AI and show “people what they can do with it."

OpenAI is working on a similar feed for ChatGPT.
Images:
  - [Image #0] The image shows a screenshot of the Meta AI app's "Discover" feed, featuring two posts. The top post is from "sophiekumar" and asks the AI to "Describe me in 3 emojis." The AI responds with three emojis: a runner, a musical note, and a dog, explaining that they were chosen because the user is training for a marathon, enjoys soundtrack scores and instrumental music, and has two furry friends at home. The post has 12 likes, 6 comments, and 9 shares.
    
    The second post is from "kfang" and asks the AI if a certain camping spot is good and if they should be worried about bears. The AI responds with a photo of a mountainous landscape with snow-capped peaks and trees, suggesting that the spot is suitable for camping. 
    
    The image also shows the app's interface, including a text input field at the bottom where users can ask Meta AI questions, and a "Talk" button to initiate a conversation. The overall design of the app is clean and modern, with a focus on showcasing the AI's capabilities and user interactions.
